links.outcome: LLM CAD-RADS scoring and management agreement with human reference standard
links.effect: Scoring agreement ranged from κ=0.637 (DeepSeek, radiologist) to 0.997 (Claude); management recommendation accuracy was considerably lower than scoring accuracy.
links.quote: The LLMs' accuracy in proposing further management was considerably lower than their scoring accuracy, with CAD-RADS 3 showing the greatest variability in management recommendations across models and between human specialists.

links.outcome: Output variation with prompt professional identity (cardiologist vs radiologist)
links.effect: ChatGPT κ=0.896 as radiologist vs 0.715 as cardiologist; DeepSeek 0.637 vs 0.768; scoring and management varied by prompt identity.
links.quote: Furthermore, both CAD-RADS scoring and management recommendations varied depending on the professional identity specified in the prompt.
